Australia

The gallery's new exhibit transforms the viewing experience into a multi-sensory journey. As visitors engage with the paintings, they are immersed in a carefully curated soundtrack that mirrors the mood and theme of each piece. To further deepen the connection, guests are provided with small sachets containing scents that correspond directly to the visuals. Additionally, interactive elements allow visitors to press on specific parts of the frame, triggering a change in texture that mimics the physical elements depicted within the artwork.
